problems.subject: client
problems.operator_action: Open the client data page, point the app at a valid installation, and verify the revision in use.

problems.subject: type dump
problems.message: No type dump is in use
problems.operator_action: Build or load a type dump for the installed client revision before the app starts reading object properties.

problems.subject: type dump
problems.message: The type dump does not match the installed client program
problems.operator_action: Rebuild the type dump for the current client revision and redeploy it before the app keeps serving data.

problems.subject: database
problems.message: A database the app needs cannot be reached
problems.operator_action: Check the database host, credentials, and connectivity, then restart or reload the affected app once the service is reachable.

problems.subject: database
problems.message: A database update is waiting to be applied
problems.operator_action: Apply the pending SQL updates for the affected server and confirm the schema version before the app accepts traffic.

problems.subject: client
problems.message: The client's revision is not one Login.AllowedRevision lists
problems.operator_action: Switch the app to an allowed client revision or update the allowed-revision list so the service can keep serving.
